goal: I want to build a consistent cycling habit and get comfortable on longer rides. I have no event or target speed.
openingMessage: I'd like a {{planSpanWeeks}}-week cycling plan. Fully prescribe the first {{prescriptionWeeks}} weeks now; I am new to structured training.

reviewAnchors.goal_fit: Support comfortable recreational cycling without inventing a race.
reviewAnchors.progression: Use the current 90 minutes/week and 45-minute longest ride, not an experienced-rider baseline.
reviewAnchors.recovery: A manageable three-ride week with understandable easy efforts and recovery.
reviewAnchors.prescriptions: Complete duration-based rides with explicit RPE and practical effort instructions when usable power data is unavailable. Do not require FTP, invented watts or power zones for effort-based cycling.
reviewAnchors.personalization: Respect bike access, available days and the longer Sunday slot; acknowledge limitations of power tests without equipment.
reviewAnchors.conversation: Discover relevant facts without unrelated sport questions; distinguish unknowns from unanswered facts, explain assumptions, and accurately describe what is saved and what remains unprescribed. Any recorded FTP must have estimated provenance and an explained basis; do not invent a measured result.
